references.text: The Lord gives the promise that He will give Ai into Israel's hand, which is the same assurance repeated in verse 7.
The ambush rises and takes the city, exactly as Joshua instructed them in verse 7.
The Lord gives Jericho into Joshua's hand, the same promise that God will give the city into their hand.
Israel uses the same ambush strategy against Gibeah, and the Lord grants victory in a similar way.
The promise that the Lord will give the enemies into Israel's hand, the same theological theme of God's gift of the land.
The Lord will give the peoples over to Israel, the same wording regarding God's handing over of enemies.
Rahab confesses that the Lord has given the land into Israel's hand, the same theme of God's gift of the land.
